notes.title: Dev Update 3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/08e2cdd294c04475b0d100a5375e28e0b90dd55d.png[/img]
[b][h1]Hello, Deminers![/h1]
[/b]It's been a while since the last Dev Update and since the project is undergoing some major structural changes - its time.

[h3][b]The less fun news:[/b][/h3]
I've been developing this game and pumping out updates over the last 1.5 years to get as far through the backlog as possible before running out of resources.. And regretfully..

..That time has sadly come, and I gotta to do a job on the side to be able to sustain development costs and all else as only doing this is [b]completely[/b] unsustainable.

[i]However..![/i] Everything has secretly been going exactly according to plan as I've managed to get so much in place during this crucial period that I'm confident that this wont impact the full-release date for the game ([b]Q2 2026[/b]) at all. Updates will be coming it more slowly, but be more substantial leading up to the full release.

[h3][b]What's next:[/b]

[u][u]Graphical Overhaul[/u][/u]
[/h3]In the next update, a complete graphical overhaul I've been cooking for up for a good while will be deployed. This overhaul completely changes the feel of the game ([i]in the good way[/i]). You will have:
[list]
[*] Increased view distances
[*] Higher texture resolutions
[*] High quality shadows
[*] More colors
[*] More details..
At the cost of... [b]15% LESS!?[/b] computing power than before. 
[/list]
Not only that... But with this tech, the game will also finally be able to support [b]full day-time[/b] which not only looks awesome, but will make the transition into nights feel much more tangible/serious.

[b]A little sneak peak of the environment during daytime using the new pipeline:[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/e1447482442b9d5f2a11737b89a28e9822abc9af.png"][/img]
[u][b][h3]Gameplay Loop Re-Design[/h3][/b][/u]With all the new features in place, the original vision for the game loop doesn't really hold up anymore or feel obvious at all. 
I'm not super hyped about there being so much in the game but so little incentive or direction for actually doing these things. I can't say for sure exactly how the game loop is going to change just yet, but there will be much more incentive for taking risks and doing different activities around the world so that making the most out of every day is back to being a clear central part of the game. 

[u][b][h3]Custom Game Settings[/h3][/b][/u]The final thing being added in the upcoming update is a way for the host to customize game settings in the lobby. Most aspects of the game will be tweakable this way like:
[list]
[*] In-Game time speed
[*] Amount of hours until dusk/nightfall happens
[*] Mine difficulty scaling
[*] Player statuses
[*] Buff durations and values
[*] Amount of ruins that can spawn individually for each sector
[*] Maximum ruins depth individually for each sector
[*] Material costs
[*] Item costs
[*] Spawn rates for every enemy
[*] Etc.. Etc..
[/list] Tweaking anything with this feature disables certain achievements in the game from being attained on that save file, but the replayability it adds to the game is priceless. 

[b]That's all i got for now. I thank you all who have been supporting and believing in my game during these somewhat messy early-access times. ːsteamhappyː[/b]

notes.title: v0.6.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/90a5af5f0f5b68aaf482dc15281e5e45d6b7507e.png[/img]
[i]Adding controller support as an afterthought has been a huge undertaking both implementation-wise and testing-wise and should have been released in a separate patch. But since that would mean no new content for non-controller users, i decided to skip 0.5.9 and head straight for 0.6.0.[/i]
[h2][b]Xbox Controller Full Support[/b][/h2][i]Demining now fully supports Xbox Controllers.[/i][list]
[*] Everything in the game has been made playable using an Xbox controller.
[*] Switching between your Xbox Controller and M&K is done seamlessly by tracking your last used input method. 
[*] A brand new flip-side of all UI components has been added to the game for controller-support and is instantly applied accordingly at any point in the game. 
[*] Disarming mines has been partly reworked so you can do it as comfortably with a controller as with M&K.[/list][h2][b]New Natural Event: Wildfires[/b][/h2][i]Exploding mines now leave random amounts of burning debris around their impact zone. These fires will gradually spread throughout the world until next rain-fall.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/78a8b9fbe774c30813af3063876653c63f94db0d.png[/img]
[h3]New Debuff / Enemy Condition: [b]Burning[/b][/h3][list][*] Players or wildlife that come in contact with fire starts burning immediately.
[*] To avoid getting grilled, afflicted players has to come in contact with water ([i]Ponds, rivers, rain[/i]) as soon as possible. 
[*] Enemies that are burning will eventually pass out. But if they hit a player before doing so, the player will be caught on fire.[/list][h2][b]Enemies[/b][/h2][i]Most enemies can now interact with the new fire and/or also step on mines. The idea is to gradually thin out the amount of mines that are active in the world to put more pressure on players in late-game and also acts as a secondary way for wildfires to erupt.[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/bbe67de2a0dd1a0b11e310565fb307872b54f229.png[/img][h3]Mad Deminer[/h3][list][*] Can now catch fire. ([i]A burning enemy will put any players they attack on fire[/i])
[*] Can now trigger mines.[/list][h3]Tiger[/h3][list][*] Can now catch fire.
[*] Can now trigger mines.[/list][h3]Nesting Spider[/h3][list]
[*] Can now catch fire.[/list][h3]Mimic[/h3][list]
[*] Can now trigger mines, but only if they have fully emerged and are on the move.[/list][h3]New Enemy: [b]Camel[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/273738af5e9e11a415f88f77696539468425a647.png[/img][i]The camel is a borderline hallucination that is only visible or heard by the player its currently hunting. If evaded, it will switch target or engage its current target from a different angle until giving up and disappearing - for the moment being.[/i][list]
[*] A new type of enemy that will sneak up on random players from behind.
[*] Like hallucinations, it will mostly only engage with players in a "worsening" mental state.
[*] It will stalk a player and is harmless for as long as you don't look at it.
[*] Camels can spawn randomly after 1AM and is guaranteed to spawn if a very distorted siren is heard at any point during your shift.
[*] Shooting will slow it down rather than stop it in it's tracks.
[*] It will stop hunting eventually if evaded a couple of times.
[*] Due to their hallucinogenic nature, they cannot interact with mines or catch fire.
[/list][h2][b]Weather[/b][/h2][list]
[*] It now visually pours rain into excavated ruins and inside the well if its raining on the surface.
[*] If extra thick fog afflicts your world, a sanity-buff will be added to inform you while its active.
[*] Removed the red-themed lightning setting from the game.[/list][h2][b]Player Character[/b][/h2][list]
[*] While inspecting your metal detector, your character no longer applies certain animations that would make it disorienting.
[*] You can now press shift/left thumbstick to toggle sprint instead of having to hold down the button to maintain running.[/list][h2][b]UI[/b][/h2][list][*] Added buttons as an alternative way to increase/decrease all slider values under options.
[*] You can now disarm mines completely without the need of using your mouse or moving your hand.
[*] You can now randomize your Units name on the menu.
[*] The friend list on the lobby screen has been properly sorted to only show online friends with the addition of a special symbol next to your friends that are playing Demining right now.
[*] Added a hover animation for items in your inventory and a completely reworked inventory interaction system if using a controller.
[*] Added a hover animation for cables on a mine.
[*] Added an overview of processed material amounts for each save-file on the save selection screen.[/list][h2][b]Bugs[/b][/h2][list][*] Fixed a visual bug where strafing and running could sometimes skip the running animation whilst applying running speed.
[*] Fixed a bug where flare gun projectiles could instantly hit the player who shot it.
[*] Fixed a bug where falling out of bounds would get you stuck in the ground upon getting teleported back to your last good location.
[*] Fixed a bug where you wouldnt be able to open the pause menu after declining the sleep popup.
[*] Fixed a bug where picking up a naturally spawned consumable would override the inventory capacity if carrying exactly 15 consumables.
[*] Fixed a bug where new weather effects could activate out of sync for a client after exiting an in-door area. ([i]I think[/i]).
[*] Fixed CPU spikes that could happen while it rained under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the players heartbeat couldn't be heard whenever it should.[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/336dc8595da24e2dc84b7f7658f7ac6b2c578736.png[/img]
[u][h2]Quest System[/h2][/u][i]This is a new system for Demining aimed to improve the beginner experience by giving a clear sense of direction when exploring the overworld. This is a completely optional activity for players to engage with and each quest yields a batch of rare materials if completed.[/i]

[h3][b]Sigvard[/b][/h3]
[*] New talkative "friendly" NPC that hangs out in base.
[*] Help Sigvard to gear up to join your Unit.
[*] Has 4 quests in total leading up to the accumulation of an important artifact needed to reach the elusive ending of the game and some rare materials along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/63243695d17ca4cdc31e01cbdf924f8f35ab174f.png[/img]

[u][h2]Player/Character[/h2][/u][*] Implemented IK (Inverse Kinematics) for the legs, so that characters legs bend relatively to the ground beneath them. This makes regular movement feel more believable (less floaty) in general and is visually satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/bf3bf8d842001b1b2e26a928aa5e2b579bc02cd8.png[/img]
[*] Added jumping / in air animations.
[*] Jumping has been heavily tuned to feel better in general.
[*] New SFX for jumping and landing.
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would float into the player's head mesh when falling / moving up fast.

[u][h2]Smoke Signals[/h2][/u][i]Helicopter Wreckage/Abandoned Campsite, etc...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/731f48b766ff25f8e1abd63902accd1e94dc487b.png[/img]
[*] Changed so that instead of them spawning randomly each day, each type of smoke signal has a determined day to spawn (maximum day 10) that is determined on the start of a new game.
[*] Changed so that only one smoke signal can be active at a time.
[*] Made it 5 times faster to interact with a smoke signal-site.

[u][h2]Mines[/h2][/u][*] Mines can now also knock most enemies caught in the explosion.
[*] Fixed a bug where mines dug up by the host wouldn't get dug up from a client perspective.

[u][h2]Enemies[/h2][/u][*] All Enemies that get knocked down are now knocked out for a random duration between 25-50 seconds. (Was previously 25 flat).
[*] Tuned max capacity of enemies for each sector to be more reasonable with how much space there is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/43debab7eccc607ed06d1686b3d5716e3c75da65.png[/img]
[h3][b]Mad Deminers[/b][/h3]
[*] Updated to match the new player movement visuals.
[*] Empowered deminers now have a clear visual difference, so its easier to determine what is what. This is also applied to Mad Deminers inside of Ruins.
[*] AI has been updated to be able to switch between walking around randomly and hunting down mines at free will, making them more unpredictable. 
[*] New passive SFX added, they can now be heard catching their breath occasionally.

[h3][b]Tigers[/b][/h3]
[*] Tigers can now spontaneously attack and knock other enemies in the overworld.

[h3][b]Visitors[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed a bug where they could be under the floor of ruins and engage with players out of sight.

[u][h2]Achievements[/h2][/u][*] New achievement for completing all of Sigvard's quests.

[u][h2]UI/Sound[/h2][/u][*] The world map now has a quest marker if a quest is active.
[*] The visual when obtaining materials has been made prettier with the addition of new SFX.
[*] Fixed a bug where loading screen tips was not appearing while in a session.
[*] Several "success" sound effects has been switched out.

notes.title: v0.5.75
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/8b9f3ac1d64f71d0699cb8cfe506e6458d8e87e4.png[/img]
[i]This is sort of a midway patch to fix, tune and polish the latest content before moving on to the next big thing, so it wont be as detailed as usual. This is a summary of the last 3 hot fixes and other additions / fixes.[/i]

[h2]New[/h2]
- Flooded chambers can now appear in the ruins. Flooded chambers are guaranteed to contain a water monster and has a random amount of debris that can be utilized to cross the chamber.
- The siren can now sound at random times after sunset, which spawns random empowered enemies around the world.
- Water ponds can now appear randomly in the world during rain.
- Thing In The Well (Water Monster) can now switch ponds while active in the overworld if left alone for a while and can also appear in new ponds that may appear while it rains.
- Added zone-name flash when entering a ruin or the lab.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a bug where lightning storm and/or rain-weather could start when exiting a dungeon of any kind.
- Fixed a bug where having flashlight turned on inside of a ruin stopped sanity from draining.
- Fixed a bug where the zone-info popup showed sometimes when digging something up.
- Fixed a bug where Visitors didnt react to players that had their radio turned on.
- Fixed a bug where Visitors could apply the madness debuff to players from an infinite range.
- Fixed a bug where a client's ability to dig could be inconsistent after looking down very fast.
- Fixed a bug where the Thing In The Well-enemy didn't visually show its location when chasing someone in the overworld.
- Fixed a bug where lightning could re-trigger infinitely under some very specific conditions in multiplayer.
- FIxed an issue where Mimics could spawn in the entrance to a ruin, essentially camping it and attacking players instantly when they enter the ruin.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Hallucination spawn rates has been re-balanced.
- Chances of the Stranger appearing later in the night to low sanity players has been increased.
- Heavily reduced the highest possible amount of damage the Thing In The Well (Water monster) can deal.
- Reduced the maximum amount of materials objectives can provide to 6. (Helicopter wreck, abandoned camp, etc).

[h2]QOL[/h2]
- Added the current amount of cash a unit has to the same screen that shows the inefficiency threshold in base.
- Moved the radio hints UI when holding it from on-screen to be part of the model instead.
- Clarified what performance mode actually is under options.
- Made material of walls darker, in an attempt to make the Text-hints during the tutorial more friendly to read.

notes.title: Dev Update 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/9bef82051421c36f2e09986eaccaedd17cc80dc6.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello Again! ːsteamhappyː [/b][/h1]
Here's another roundup of the latest notable changes and additions to Demining.

These weeks have been busy. I've visually reworked the market, made the ATV fully compatible in multiplayer but these are the most...
[h2]Standout Improvements / Changes / Additions[/h2]

[b][h3][*]Achievements![/h3][/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/ca02c36e95168ca14f3f5932e3e9144b27f96c78.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/c1495f1fec89298071e48a3d6a45d8171f0701ca.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/506d289e1f7cb87ce41745dad3a4358809d5e3a0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/cfd118fd20d2b715c1945d5b58e7b31bda0f9a86.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/0bf74b3d215b95bdd5081015425d8c2f7a1b6e2d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/061d7c16682736a670f094f0d6a68f7807833e99.png[/img][/url]
[i]Achievements were supposed to be in the game on release but some other more pressing issues came in the way. Now i'm happy to announce that there are 18 achievements up for grabs, where some may provide hints about content you have yet to discover.[/i] 

[b][h3][*]Overworld Changes[/h3][/b]
[i]The large open tent in lowlands used to serve a purpose in an earlier unreleased version of the game. However, that purpose doesn't exist anymore and it felt like to me that it was only standing in the way for players that wanted to utilize the ATV. I also been meaning to add more dense vegetation to the game so kind of took out two birds with one stone here.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/6aa85d819ed4201231ca786b20ae7f6b6fcb7136.png[/img]

[i]While at it, I also made the decision to close down the well for now as it similarly to the Lowlands tent mentioned above - has lost its purpose over time. For now, I've added a lid on top of the well which I intend to turn into a puzzle in the future as may be slightly hinted on the model for it. 

The artifact that could previously be found in the well under certain conditions, can now instead be found on top of the lid if those conditions are met so you don't have to go down to fetch it anymore, for now.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/b8d2a3b99edfdcd4e136255678b3623f83e73261.png[/img]

[i]Lastly, random scenic objects now appears in each sector for each day, which is part of some ongoing work to keep the experience fresh for each new day. The pool of objects that can spawn are partly the same objects which a Mimic can hide under so you can never be truly sure of what you think is a mimic anymore unless you see it twitching.[/i]

[b][h3][*]New Hallucination[/h3][/b]
[i]Initially the game had 3 hallucinations, where one was scrapped right before launch which kind of left the system feel a bit empty. This guy was initially going to be another "Turtle", but one thing led to another. This new hallucination can approach several players at once and also overlap with other active hallucinations. Once he's latched onto a player, he will always follow them around but very slowly for the rest of the day unless its baited into a Spotlight. 

So be sure to keep your sanity high![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/ebb3e462dd21c4bc2e440400d03153805bd315fb.gif[/img]

[b][h3][*]Reworked the disarming section of the tutorial.[/h3][/b]
[i]Previously, there were always 5 mines to disarm in the tutorials that could be disarmed by anyone. Meaning that if 1 player disarmed all 5 mines, the other 3 players would be left with none. To address this - There are now several "disarm chambers" that will open up when getting to that part of the tutorial. Each chamber has 4 mines to disarm and is individually assigned to players in the game.[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/796789200d02f2a4e7d7ca996cd4610462025eac.png[/img]

[h2]About the frequent/daily patches...[/h2]
[b]This is not sustainable for my health[/b]. Now that the game runs well, most obvious bugs are fixed and many QOL features are implemented I will slow down on the updating. I will instead update the game only when there is a substantial amount of new/changed content. 
If there are any game breaking or soft locking issues I will still hot-fix it on the current version, but hold back on releasing the new stuff til its spicy enough.

This is both for my sake but also to make sure that returning deminers feel like its worth checking out/coming back for.


[b]That's all I got for now.

Thank you for readingːsteamhappyː[/b]

notes.title: Dev Update 1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello!ːsteamhappyː[/b]
To better include everyone who's been following or trying out the game, I’ll be sharing occasional summaries highlighting notable changes, improvements, and what’s currently in the works. These updates are meant to keep you in the loop and give some insight into the development process as it evolves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/8facd385556933ecdf0e89ba82ae60e5e41f7cbd.png[/img]

[i]In hindsight, the initial version of the game had some serious issues in terms of optimization, explanation of game mechanics or presentation in general. 
I've never published a game before and the initial build clearly lacked the quality I truly believed I would have time to sort out before the game inevitably came out.[/i]

Among a plethora of bug fixes and QOL-Improvements in all regards, these are the...
[h2]Standout Improvements / Changes:[/h2]

[*] [b]Reworked how static objects and lightning is rendered in the game.[/b]
[i]While strong systems didn't experience GPU/CPU spikes to the same extent, if you were hovering around the minimum requirements to run the game - It was awful for no good reason. 
Obviously, there was a reason and it has been massively improved since. I will still keep looking for ways to improve the performance of the game and passively send out updates in this regard in coming patches but the improvements made can be clearly felt in-game and seen when monitoring your cpu/gpu which is great.[/i]

[*] [b]Completely scrapped the previous tutorial and replaced it with a brand new (optional) introductory area.[/b]
[i]It is safe to say that the initial tutorial was horrible. Pretty much every player I saw play the game during the first week struggled with understanding the fundamentals of the game. Being dropped into the game right away with several different interactables and a wall of text covering half your screen was not the way - So I completely deleted it and reworked the new player-experience from scratch. There will still be patches made to the new and improved tutorial, even though its much better than before it still contains some elements that can be simplified further. The mission to not overwhelm new players continues, but its much more digestable now.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/75883d60f87571b95708666a4793a015d6ccf6fb.png[/img]

[*] [b] Labyrinth puzzle mechanic when disarming mines removed & replaced[/b]
[i] Another thing i saw players struggle with heavily, has been the maze/labyrinth puzzle when disarming mines. So I reworked the labyrinth puzzle into a new maze-like mechanic that is more fair, visually satisfying, varying and most importantly self-explanatory.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517178/f0de08f613e9b7c02ab2231f8c9d7b11daa39cd4.png[/img]

[h2]Upcoming:[/h2]
[*] [b]ATV improvements and changes[/b]
[i] The ATV was a heavily experimental feature added to the game a bit too close to the release which is why its limited to one zone only but it's very clear to me at this point that the ATV is a fun addition for players and its here to stay. 
The ATV will see improvements in terms of smoothness for clients(those who aren't hosting a session), more dynamic/realistic steering, a much larger fuel pool and also being able to access more areas with it. 
Another goal that I aim to implement is the ability to store items in the ATV, so you can stash treasures in it for an example, allowing you drive around and plunder as many ruins as you want without having to return to camp.[/i]

[*] [b]Enemy Improvements[/b]
[i]While they work fine mostly, I want all enemies to have much more distinctive/noticeable behaviors.
For an example: all enemies currently have wildly different behaviors depending on if they are encountered in the Overworld or inside of a Ruin and also if they spawn as a reaction to a siren going off or what time it is. 
I'm quite certain this goes completely unnoticed, especially for new players or players that doesn't spend some time within the game so the presentation there is definitely lacking. 
So to summarize, there will be improvements in terms of visual feedback, sounds, and in some cases changes to the enemy models depending on the conditions mentioned above to clarify exactly what you're dealing with.[/i]

[*] [b] Market UI Rework[/b]
[i]The Market UI will be reworked to be less confusing, with the buying of items and selling of materials being completely separated into different tabs. General facelift incoming.[/i]

[b]That's all I got [i]for now[/i] *tips fedora*
Thanks for reading!ːsteamhappyː[/b]

[h3]Overall[/h3]
[*] Some enemies could overlap their own sounds when interacting with players under certain conditions fixed.

[h3]Mimic[/h3]
[*] Mimic spawn issues under certain conditions fixed.
[*] Mimics spawning outside of bounds in the upper Well Excavation or in-door areas in the overworld fixed.
[*] Edge case where mimics would get confused if not finding a viable spawn point fixed.

[h2]💎  Ruins[/h2]
[h3]Traps[/h3]
[*] Spin-Traps can now move to make them more interesting.

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[*] Moved a few scuffed enemy paths that tended to make certain enemy types stuck under certain conditions.

notes.title: v0.5.22
notes.notes:
[*] Fixed a few audio issues with enemies
[*] Fixed so that the Grand Ruins sector can be properly hovered over on the world map in camp.
[*] Fixed scuffed light pole collisions

notes.title: Main menu memory leak hotfix
notes.notes:
[*] Fixed a memory leak causing the game to freeze when pressing the "Create Lobby"-button after idling for a while.
[*] Fixed an issue where a ready-lamp would not turn back to red after a readied player left a lobby.

notes.title: Update addressing some minor issues.
notes.notes:
[h2]🖥️ UI[/h2]
[*][b][Visual Clipping][/b] When receiving the daily paycheck, the "Stamp of Approval" overlaps the Continue button if playing with 4 players. The button is still clickable but barely visible.

[h2]🐾 Enemies / AI[/h2]
[h1]Mimic[/h1]
[*]The mimic can now transform into a larger variety of objects inside of ruins where they previously were limited to just one because of debugging logic accidently being pushed in the previous version.

notes.title: Early Access Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Early Access is now finally available!🚀[/h3]

There are a few standout bugs that [i]may[i] be noticeable and are listed under a thread in the community forum found here on Steam. I simply ran out of time and doing last second builds didn't seem like the right decision tonight.
A Discord server is on the way where these things will also be addressed moving forward, but before its up I will monitor the forum here on Steam like a hawk.
I also opened up a thread on the forums for submitting Feedback.

Bugs and/or feedback submissions can also be be sent through the [url=https://demininggame.com/]website[/url] directly to me.

That's It, Hope you enjoy the game!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 100+ Wishlists!
notes.notes:
Hey!

Currently working day and night on fixing and quadruple checking every corner of the game for the upcoming release but I had to take a moment just to say that i really appreciate you all for adding the game to your wishlists.

This project started off as a "cute little single-player experience" that was meant to last a week while I was finishing up my studies. That week turned into a month and the game became my full-time occupation somewhere around there. That month turned into more than a year - and here we are.

100 May not seem like a big number but it means the world to me.

So [b]thank you[/b]!!! ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː



[b]On another note:[/b]
I'm absolutely prioritizing the actual game above all else right now, but there will be a Discord server coming up soon that will be linked here on the Steam page.
The Discord server will replace the current setup of going through the website/steam to get in touch with me regarding any issues and/or thoughts about the game once its released.
If the Discord isn't up once the game is released, it wont be long. 

[i]Meantime, I will be monitoring the steam page and submissions made through the website like a hawk.[/i]
